jobs.prompt: Rebuild auto-approve v1 on a CLEAN main so that git and swarm merge handling are identical to main by construction. Eight Opus reviews of the old branch kept finding that its edits to the guard files changed git and merge behaviour. Reference material, read-only: coordination/review/aa-ref/auto-approve-policy.mjs (the policy module of the old branch, already reviewed seven times: reuse its file-window logic), auto-approve.test.mjs, auto-approve.md, and old-hooks.diff (how the old branch hooked into tools/handbuild.mjs, tools/shell-writes.mjs and tools/self-approval.mjs; it contains git and merge hunks that must NOT be carried over). Requirements: (1) Put essentially all logic in tools/auto-approve-policy.mjs (copy and trim the reference: file-window logic only, no git code, no swarm handbuild git, no pinned git, no push or switch rules, no standing-merge changes, no project-root policy.json lookup, no basename tricks). (2) The hooks into tools/handbuild.mjs, tools/shell-writes.mjs and tools/self-approval.mjs must be small and strictly about file-edit windows: at most about 60 changed lines in total across the three files, no change to how any command is classified (git detection stays exactly as on main, node swarm.mjs handling stays as on main, the swarm merge and standing-merge paths stay byte for byte as on main, SAFE_SWARM patterns stay as on main unless a safe-list entry for the window requests is strictly needed). Verify at the end with git diff against main that no git or merge hunk exists. (3) File-edit windows: the owner's policy can auto-approve Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and analysed shell writes of EXACT files under docs/state only (no other folder), extensions .md .txt .csv .ndjson, basename not an instruction file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, README.md, SKILL.md, CLAUDE.local.md, any file ending .instructions.md, .rules.md or .local.md), no dot-folder component, exact listed spelling compared in a canonical form (resolved, case-folded on darwin), lstat checks so symlinks, dangling symlinks, symlinked ancestors and hard links (nlink above 1) and non-regular files are rejected, re-checked at write time through the guard (including a no-follow open and fstat when the guard writes); link-producing commands (ln, link, cp -l/--link/-s/--symbolic-link, install, rsync, tar and unzip extraction, mv onto a window path) touching a window path are owner-only; the kill switch, expiry, per-window and per-day caps apply to every approval path that a policy row covers (only those); stats.json initialised by the policy under the lock with an initialised marker, a missing file after that is limit reached, never persist an unreadable flag; the policy file and any override variable are honoured only under the signed test marker; a Bash allow covered by a policy row with an empty file list is denied; the machine policy.json and the handbuild state folder are protected from session writes; protected owner files list (case-folded on darwin): SSH config, known_hosts, authorized_keys and rc, the git credentials file, global and XDG git config, ignore and attributes files, shell startup files under the home directory. (4) Port the tests from the reference that apply to file windows, drop git, merge and docs/design tests, add a test for each requirement above, and add tests proving unchanged behaviour for git (a git push and a git commit are classified and denied exactly as before with a policy window live) and for swarm merge. (5) docs/auto-approve.md for the files-only feature with a 'Deviations from main' section that says none for git or merge. Also add the 'Parked: git actions under policy' section to docs/plans/ideas.md (needs pinned git, atomic checks in one process, protected git common dir, push by literal URL with explicit refspec, staged-file check, cwd equals root). Do not copy anything from coordination/review/aa-ref into outputs; leave that folder untouched. Keep every orchestrator-mode, handbuild, guard, self-approval, completion and swarm-merge test passing.
